book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 3 The D-Day Landings 诺曼底登陆
source: 外研社版(新标准)选择性必修第三册 Unit 3 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、二战/D-Day/和平主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The fighting on the beach was sudden and violent.
words.example_cn: 海滩上的战斗来得突然而猛烈。

words.example_en: Few soldiers were ready for the violence they met at Omaha Beach.
words.example_cn: 很少有士兵对他们在奥马哈海滩遭遇的暴力有所准备。

words.example_en: The D-Day landings began at dawn on 6 June 1944.
words.example_cn: 诺曼底登陆于1944年6月6日黎明开始。

words.meaning_cn: (第二次世界大战)同盟国的;联合的
words.example_en: The Allied troops were made up of British, Canadian and American soldiers.
words.example_cn: 同盟国部队由英国、加拿大和美国士兵组成。

words.example_en: Thousands of troops crossed the English Channel that night.
words.example_cn: 那天夜里,数千名士兵渡过了英吉利海峡。

words.example_en: The commanders waited for the right moon and tide before the attack.
words.example_cn: 指挥官们等到合适的月相和潮水后才发起进攻。

words.example_en: General Eisenhower was the Supreme Commander of the Allied forces.
words.example_cn: 艾森豪威尔将军是同盟国部队的最高指挥官。

words.example_en: The commander gave the order to begin Operation Overlord.
words.example_cn: 指挥官下令开始“霸王行动”。

words.example_en: Thousands of soldiers landed by parachute behind enemy lines.
words.example_cn: 数千名士兵乘降落伞降落在敌后。

words.example_en: Their objective was to reach the Normandy beaches before noon.
words.example_cn: 他们的目标是在中午前到达诺曼底海滩。

words.example_en: The attack covered about 80 kilometres of French coastline.
words.example_cn: 进攻沿着约80公里的法国海岸线展开。

words.example_en: On the beach the men saw the full horror of war.
words.example_cn: 在海滩上,这些人见识到了战争全部的恐怖。

words.example_en: Some boats were hit and many men drowned before reaching land.
words.example_cn: 一些船只被击中,许多人还没上岸就淹死了。

words.example_en: Those who made it to the beach faced heavy machine gunfire.
words.example_cn: 上了海滩的人面对着猛烈的机枪火力。

words.example_en: By mid-morning, bodies lay among the tanks on the sand.
words.example_cn: 到上午中段,尸体散落在沙滩的坦克之间。

words.example_en: One soldier recalled how he barely made it across the beach.
words.example_cn: 一名士兵回忆起他是如何勉强冲过海滩的。

words.example_en: With bombs falling all around, he barely made it to safety.
words.example_cn: 炸弹在四周落下,他勉强才到达安全地带。

words.meaning_cn: 解放(城市、国家等);使获自由
words.example_en: By late August, the Allies had liberated Paris.
words.example_cn: 到8月底,同盟国已解放了巴黎。

words.example_en: People came together for memorial ceremonies on both sides of the Channel.
words.example_cn: 人们在海峡两岸聚集举行纪念仪式。

words.example_en: The ceremony was a solemn and moving occasion for everyone there.
words.example_cn: 对在场的每个人来说,这场仪式都庄严而动人。

words.example_en: World leaders today condemn the cruelty of every war.
words.example_cn: 今天的世界领导人谴责一切战争的残酷。

words.example_en: Their outstanding acts of courage will always be remembered.
words.example_cn: 他们杰出的勇敢行为将永远被铭记。

words.example_en: The soldiers' uniforms were torn and covered in mud.
words.example_cn: 士兵们的制服破烂不堪,沾满了泥。

words.example_en: The enemy bombed the city more than two hundred times.
words.example_cn: 敌人对这座城市轰炸了两百多次。

words.example_en: China plays an important role in UN peacekeeping today.
words.example_cn: 如今中国在联合国维和行动中发挥着重要作用。

words.example_en: The peacekeepers helped warring parties keep to their agreements.
words.example_cn: 维和人员帮助交战各方遵守协议。

words.example_en: Peacekeepers monitor the peace in areas that have experienced friction.
words.example_cn: 维和人员监督那些曾发生冲突地区的和平。

words.example_en: They worked to disarm combatants and secure their weapons.
words.example_cn: 他们努力解除战斗人员的武装并收缴其武器。

words.example_en: Each combatant was asked to hand over his weapon.
words.example_cn: 每名战斗人员都被要求交出武器。

words.example_en: The team secured the weapons and removed them from use.
words.example_cn: 该小组收缴了武器并使其停止使用。

words.example_en: Soldiers carried only as much ammunition as they could lift.
words.example_cn: 士兵们只携带他们能扛得动的弹药。

words.example_en: These measures aim to give stability to conflict zones.
words.example_cn: 这些举措旨在为冲突地区带来稳定。

words.example_en: Chinese forces have received praise for their professionalism.
words.example_cn: 中国部队因其专业素质而受到赞扬。

words.example_en: The three universities joined to protect their academic heritage.
words.example_cn: 三所大学联合起来保护他们的学术遗产。

words.example_en: The aggression of the enemy army brought disaster to the country.
words.example_cn: 敌军的侵略给这个国家带来了灾难。

words.example_en: They were determined to save the nation's intellectual heritage.
words.example_cn: 他们决心拯救民族的智识遗产。

words.example_en: Many of China's leading scholars emerged from that wartime university.
words.example_cn: 中国许多顶尖学者都出自那所战时大学。

words.example_en: Many students joined the army to resist the invaders.
words.example_cn: 许多学生参军抵抗侵略者。

words.example_en: The poet depicted the courage of his peers in a moving poem.
words.example_cn: 诗人在一首动人的诗中描绘了同伴们的勇气。

words.meaning_cn: 同龄人;同辈;同等地位的人
words.example_en: He was admired by his peers for his bravery.
words.example_cn: 他因勇敢而受到同辈的敬佩。

words.example_en: The university became the crowning glory of the nation's education.
words.example_cn: 这所大学成了民族教育辉煌的顶峰。

words.example_en: The school was famous for its prominent professors.
words.example_cn: 这所学校以其杰出的教授而闻名。

words.example_en: Its spirit of dedication still inspires students today.
words.example_cn: 它的奉献精神至今仍激励着学生。

words.example_en: Representatives from four universities gathered to mark the day.
words.example_cn: 来自四所大学的代表聚集起来纪念这一天。

words.example_en: They gathered to commemorate the soldiers who had died.
words.example_cn: 他们聚集起来纪念阵亡的士兵。

words.example_en: In 2017 they marked the 80th anniversary of its founding.
words.example_cn: 2017年他们纪念了它建校80周年。

words.example_en: The story has become part of the nation's collective memory.
words.example_cn: 这个故事已成为民族集体记忆的一部分。

words.example_en: The enemy offered a large sum of money for the hero's head.
words.example_cn: 敌人为这位英雄的人头出了一大笔钱。

words.example_en: They found tree bark in his stomach but not a single grain of rice.
words.example_cn: 他们在他胃里发现的是树皮,却没有一粒米。

words.meaning_cn: 有关的;切题的;有意义的
words.example_en: The lessons of that war are still relevant to us today.
words.example_cn: 那场战争的教训对今天的我们仍有意义。
